narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates obligated $842M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Brookhaven Science Associates received 2 awards so far, with an average award size of $421M, and obligations are up 1.0% year over year. The Department of Energy is the dominant buyer, obligating $842M. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration also purchased services, obligating $16K. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the principal market, accounting for $842M in obligations. A secondary market entry, Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology), shows $16K in obligations. Fiscal-year history shows obligations of $668M in FY21, $951M in FY22, $789M in FY23, $797M in FY24, $834M in FY25, and $842M in FY26. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date, and largest-awards and expiring-contracts figures in the source are total contract values rather than annual obligations.

sections.heading: How has Brookhaven Science Associates' federal business trended over recent years?
sections.body: Brookhaven Science Associates' obligations rose from $668M in FY21 to $951M in FY22, then moved to $789M in FY23 and $797M in FY24. Brookhaven Science Associates' obligations were $834M in FY25 and $842M in FY26, and obligations are up 1.0% year over year.

sections.heading: Who are the main buyers and which markets drive Brookhaven Science Associates' work?
sections.body: The Department of Energy is the primary buyer, obligating $842M. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration is a secondary buyer, obligating $16K.
